$comment: Mission 1.59 sections 48 to 67. The full sixteen-gate recomputation, the structural fixtures, the verdict and the handoff.
mission: 1.59 — Internet-Wide Service-Presence Route Gate Closure V1
primary_outcome_statement: The two apparatuses publish different kinds of temporal object. One is a stream of observations each carrying the time it was made; the other is a maintained current state whose searchable time field records when a record last changed. No time-selection rule can be frozen before values are retrieved, so the pair cannot support a preregistered threshold proposition.
why_no_actionability: Section 50 assigns an actionability level only to a route that passed. None did.

gate_matrix.$comment: Section 48. Every gate recomputed, with its previous value beside it. A previously passing gate is allowed to move.

gates.reason: both apparatuses probe the public IPv4 space for responding services
a named protocol is an exact subject

the construct is now defined protocol-natively against RFC 4253 and needs no vendor fingerprint, which resolves the semantic half. What is not established is that either apparatus exposes a query surface deciding that predicate rather than its own assigned service label.
hosts on both sides, no conversion

established from first-party documentation on both sides: a stream of timestamped observations against a merged current state whose searchable time is a last-change time, with no documented aggregate observation-window selector. The only remaining pairing procedure is the retrospective one section 18 forbids.

REOPENED. One apparatus documents that under high service density its service data represents a SAMPLING of service details, so its record is not necessarily a census of that host's services. Vantage-relative reachability was also never established for either side. Section 28 forbids calling a partial frame internet-wide.
either count alone decides a threshold
no authoritative published host-presence count exists to be republished, and no load-bearing common measurement upstream was found
separate scanners, separate port lists, separate parsing
strengthened on apparatus B from an absence to a positive statement about the load-bearing records, and still short of an affirmative statement that no external measurement feed is load-bearing

REOPENED. Section 52. Both publish methodology, and the narrowed metric now depends on how each decides a wire-level predicate. Whether that decision procedure is documented well enough for a human to review its dependability is not established, and one side's fingerprinting is proprietary.
section 34 forbids the governance review in this mission, so this gate was not targeted and could not close
REOPENED as a consequence of gate 5. A threshold can only be frozen before both retrievals if the observations it will be compared against can be identified in advance, and they cannot.
a host count against a bound admits observations on either side

observable service presence across a defined public frame bears on AUDIENCE_OR_USAGE and COMPETITIVE_SUPPLY, and the protocol narrowing did not detach it: the construct did not have to name a product to remain interesting

gate_matrix.reopening_is_success_of_the_audit: Section 30. Three gates that passed a mission ago now read worse under fuller information. That is the audit process working, not the mission failing: they were passing on less evidence than they are now failing on.

structural_fixtures.$comment: Sections 53 and 54. Synthetic values only, never persisted, and chosen so nobody can mistake them for measurements.

same_claim_identity.setup: one source-independent TargetProposition P; witness A carries a value above the bound, witness B below it
same_claim_identity.result: identical proposition_key for both witness shapes
same_claim_identity.what_it_proves: the protocol narrowing did not sneak scanner identity into Claim identity. Scanner identity is witness provenance, and the same Claim accepts both measurements.
same_claim_identity.values_used: clearly synthetic, and no real measurement was retrieved to construct them

independent_support.setup: same P, both witnesses SUPPORTS, both KNOWN_INDEPENDENT

disagreement_diagnostic.question: If apparatus A and B disagree, is that potentially a fact about the world or necessarily a bug?
disagreement_diagnostic.why: each apparatus generates its observations by probing, so a difference can be coverage, timing or vantage rather than a transcription error
disagreement_diagnostic.the_caveat_this_mission_adds: That answer is only meaningful once the observations can be attributed to a common window. Under this pair they cannot, so a disagreement could ALSO be an artefact of one side's searchable timestamp meaning last-change rather than last-observed. A contradiction produced that way would be an artefact recorded as a finding, which is why gate 5 is not negotiable.

threshold.why_not: Section 40. The acquisition contract is not governed or frozen, and choosing a bound now would be choosing a number for a route that does not qualify.
threshold.why_not_for_this_pair: Preregistration requires that the observations the bound will be compared against can be identified before retrieval. Gate 5 establishes they cannot.
threshold.can_it_for_the_class: YES, for a pair whose apparatuses both expose observation-addressable data

what_survives.$comment: The pair is dropped. Three things outlive it, and they are why this mission was worth running.
what_survives.the_protocol_native_construct: A service-presence metric can be defined against a published standard with no vendor taxonomy, and the definition is written source-free so any future pair can be asked for it.
what_survives.the_new_apparatus_requirement: OBSERVATION_ADDRESSABLE_EXPOSURE. An apparatus qualifies only if a future observation can be attributed to a defined window from its published surface, BEFORE any value is retrieved. This is not the same as scanning often, and Mission 1.58 could not have known to ask for it.
what_survives.the_diagnostic_that_generalises: A dataset can be excellent and still be the wrong temporal object. A maintained current-state view answers what is running now; a preregistered threshold proposition asks what was observed during a window. Both are legitimate products and only one of them can witness this kind of Claim.
what_survives.the_lineage_advance: Apparatus B's provenance moved from an absence of a denial to a positive statement about the load-bearing records, which carries forward if it appears in a future pair.

next_mission_recommendation.name: Mission 1.60 — Observation-Addressable Scanner Pair Selection V1
next_mission_recommendation.why_this: Section 67. On SNAPSHOT_TIME_SEMANTICS_NOT_ALIGNABLE the instruction is to drop the pair, not the class, and not to pay for governance or access. The class survives: the structural independence argument is untouched and the protocol-native construct is now written down.
it_should: add OBSERVATION_ADDRESSABLE_EXPOSURE as a gate applied BEFORE a pair is selected, so the next pair is not chosen and then discovered to be the wrong temporal object
ask the vantage and frame questions before selection too, since gate 6 reopened on a sampling disclosure that was there to be read
carry the protocol-native construct forward unchanged rather than redefining it
carry apparatus B forward as a candidate side, since its exposure model is the one that fits
seek a second observation-addressable scanner and establish its lineage affirmatively
it_must_not: fetch a measurement value, a host count or a result total
purchase access or start a trial that exposes target measurements
accept a vendor product label as the metric definition
read an absence of a reference to third-party data as an affirmative statement
register a source or create a governance review
